title: Bundled font loads via CWD-relative path with silent GetFontDefault fallback — any non-root launch silently renders the default font
evidence:
+// FONT_ASSET — the bundled HUD font (SIL OFL 1.1, license at
+// assets/fonts/OFL.txt). Loaded at app/harness init from the repo root cwd
+// (both run from the root); committed, so the load never depends on a system
+// font — the atlas is byte-deterministic across platforms (the T2 spine).
+FONT_ASSET :: "assets/fonts/open_sans_regular.ttf"
+FONT_BASE_SIZE :: 64 // the atlas size — downscaled to HUD sizes (14-22px)
+
+// load_hud_font — load the bundled Open Sans Regular at FONT_BASE_SIZE with
+// bilinear filtering (smooth at HUD sizes; the prototype's font story used
+// the same LoadFontEx(…, 64, …) + BILINEAR recipe). Fallback: the raylib
+// default font (belt+braces — the asset is committed, so the fallback is
+// unreachable in practice; the prototype kept the same guard).
+load_hud_font :: proc() -> rl.Font {
+	f := rl.LoadFontEx(FONT_ASSET, FONT_BASE_SIZE, nil, 0)
+	if rl.IsFontValid(f) {
+		rl.SetTextureFilter(f.texture, .BILINEAR)
+		return f
+	}
+	return rl.GetFontDefault()
+}
detail: Nothing enforces the assumed repo-root cwd — it is only a comment. Launched elsewhere (double-click, wrong shell dir) the app silently renders GetFontDefault, the exact reported defect, and a wrong-cwd harness re-bless would poison T2 goldens.
recommended_fix: Resolve FONT_ASSET against the executable/repo root (or embed the font in the binary); make the harness load failure loud (abort) instead of silently returning GetFontDefault.

title: Frozen spec says SetWindowMinSize runs before InitWindow; the code (correctly) calls it after
evidence:
+(2) Restore resize: `SetConfigFlags({.WINDOW_RESIZABLE})` + `SetWindowMinSize` before init (prototype pattern); HUD math moves off `WIN_W/WIN_H` constants onto the live `view.win_w/win_h`; camera-fit already reveals more map (GL5.2 aspect=expand); pause edge-chip becomes gap-adaptive.

+- **Resize**: `SetConfigFlags({.WINDOW_RESIZABLE})` + `SetWindowMinSize(1152, 648)` before InitWindow (prototype pattern).

+	rl.SetConfigFlags({.WINDOW_RESIZABLE}) // v2-ux-font-resize: the prototype's pattern (before InitWindow)
 	rl.InitWindow(WIN_W, WIN_H, "Packet Plumber - v2 story 4.3 (network health + win/lose/retry)")
+	rl.SetWindowMinSize(MIN_WIN_W, MIN_WIN_H) // clamp so the HUD bands can't collapse
detail: The frozen human-owned intent states SetWindowMinSize precedes InitWindow (twice); the implementation sets it after, because raylib requires an existing window. Spec and code contradict; the spec wording is unimplementable as written.
recommended_fix: Amend the spec's Approach and Design Notes to "SetConfigFlags before InitWindow; SetWindowMinSize after InitWindow", matching the code, so the frozen intent matches reality.

title: Comments claim DrawTextEx spacing 1 is "the same spacing raylib's DrawText used" — DrawText passes 0.0f, so every string widens by len-1 px
evidence:
+// 2026-08-15 (v2-ux-font-resize): draws with the bundled HUD font via
+// DrawTextEx (spacing 1 — the same spacing raylib's DrawText used, so only
+// the glyph METRICS change, never the spacing semantics).

+	// v2-ux-font-resize: the bundled HUD font via DrawTextEx (spacing 1 — the
+	// same spacing raylib's DrawText used; only the glyph metrics change).
+	rl.DrawTextEx(app.view.font, cstring(raw_data(cbuf)), {f32(x), f32(y)}, f32(size), 1, col)
detail: raylib's DrawText forwards to DrawTextEx with spacing 0.0f, not 1. Spacing semantics DO change: each string gains (len-1) px of width, so the "only glyph metrics change" justification in both comments is false.
recommended_fix: Correct both comments to state spacing changes 0 → 1 (deliberate +1px per inter-glyph gap), or pass 0 if true DrawText parity is intended.

title: Pause-chip two-line threshold (104px) contradicts its own hint measurement: ~98px line + 8px inset needs ≥106px
evidence:
+			// (PAUSED + hint) when the gap >= 104px (the hint needs ~98px +
+			// padding — measured from the rendered 12px line), a single 14px

+			gap_l := f32(app.view.win_w) / 2 + 240 // health card right edge + 10
+			gap_r := f32(app.view.win_w) - 260     // forecast card left edge - 10
+			avail := gap_r - gap_l
+			chip_w := f32(clamp(i32(avail), 64, 120))

+			draw_text(&app, "PAUSED", i32(chip.x) + 8, i32(chip.y) + 4, 14, p.ink_soft)
+			if avail >= 104 {
+				draw_text(&app, "P/Space to resume", i32(chip.x) + 8, i32(chip.y) + 21, 12, p.ink_soft)
+			}
detail: At avail=104 chip_w=104; the hint draws at +8 inset, leaving 96px of interior — but the comment itself measures the hint at ~98px. Threshold and measurement cannot both be right; the hint grazes the chip border.
recommended_fix: Raise the two-line threshold to avail >= 110 (or reduce the hint's x inset) so the measured ~98px line fits inside chip_w at the boundary.
